crashReporter.title: Crash reporter cleanup
crashReporter.description: Work around an empty crash-report window for games that ship a buggy reporter by removing its crash reporter files before launch. This is off by default and may not be needed for every game.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: If something goes wrong, open the log file and attach it to your bug report.

nexusAccount.title: Nexus Mods Account
nexusAccount.description: Sign in with your Nexus Mods account in your browser. Tokens are stored locally and never leave this device.
nexusAccount.sessionExpired: Your sign-in expired and was cleared. This happens when the session is revoked, the account password changes, or Modrex goes unused long enough for it to lapse.
nexusAccount.signOutConfirmBody: You'll need to sign in again in your browser to browse and install Nexus Mods.
nexusAccount.insecureStorage: Your Nexus Mods sign-in is stored less securely because no OS credential store is available. On Linux, install and enable a Secret Service provider such as gnome-keyring or KWallet, then restart Modrex to fix this.

folders.title: Folders

storage.title: Storage
storage.dangerZoneDescription: These actions delete locally stored data. Caches free disk space and rebuild automatically as you use the app; resetting restores default settings. None of them remove your installed mods or game files.
storage.clearAllDescription: Clears cached images, mod info, the identification database, and news together.
storage.clearConfirmBody: This deletes the cached data now. Modrex rebuilds it automatically as you use the app.
storage.clearAllConfirmBody: This deletes all cached images, mod info, the identification database, and news. Modrex rebuilds them automatically as you use the app.
storage.cachedImagesDescription: Mod thumbnails and banners from ModWorkshop.
storage.cachedModInfoDescription: Saved mod names, versions, and details.
storage.modIndexDescription: The hash index used to recognize your installed mods.
storage.newsDescription: Saved copies of the in-app news pages.
storage.resetDescription: Restore all app settings to their defaults.
storage.resetConfirmBody: This clears your saved game paths, launcher choices, preferences, and analytics choice, then returns Modrex to its first-run state. Your installed mods and game files are not affected.

crimeBossInstallMode.title: New Mod Installs
crimeBossInstallMode.description: Where new Crime Boss mods go by default. You can also move an already-installed mod later from the Installed list.

about.supportBody: Modrex is free and built in spare time. If it saves you time, a GitHub star or a sponsorship helps keep it going.
about.disclaimer: Modrex is a community project and is not affiliated with the developers or publishers of the supported games.

supportPrompt.body: Enjoying Modrex? A star on GitHub helps other players find it.

telemetry.title: Help improve Modrex
telemetry.intro: Modrex can send anonymous usage data so we can see which mods break, which games need attention, and what to build next. It's optional, and you can change this anytime in Settings.
telemetry.collect1: Anonymous usage: features used, mods installed, and how well mods are identified
telemetry.collect2: Your app version and operating system
telemetry.dontCollect1: No names, emails, accounts, or anything that identifies you
telemetry.dontCollect2: No file paths, mod search text, or other personal data
telemetry.privacyPrefix: Usage data is processed by Google Analytics. See
telemetry.settingsDescription: Share anonymous usage data to help improve Modrex.
telemetry.discordPresenceDescription: Show Modrex activity on your Discord profile with a link to the app.
